limitations: Metrics depend on the completeness and correctness of labels.
Synthetic results do not establish production effectiveness.
TN is zero when no complete evaluation population is supplied.
Overall metrics are micro-averaged across rule/event classifications.
Latency is local detector execution time only.
Only explicitly labelled positive scenarios are evaluated.
Synthetic results do not establish production effectiveness.
matching_policy: Per-rule event-ID matching: intersection of ground-truth positive IDs and alert event_ids is TP; predicted IDs outside that rule's positive set are FP; missed positive IDs are FN; remaining events are TN.
